latestVersion.changelog:
aml-kyc-docs 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a compliance documentation generator for UK Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations.
- Supports generation of key AML records: due diligence forms, risk assessments, policies, and draft Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).
- Offers 15 document templates tailored to specific business needs, including standard, enhanced, and simplified due diligence.
- User-invocable skill with guided prompts based on business type and documentation need.
- Includes clear legal disclaimers for every generated document, outlining scope and limitations.
